note: Redacted transcripts of the end-to-end suites run against a local production build with PayPal sandbox keys and a fresh database: each step, the PayPal resource ids and statuses the run saw, and timings. Written by tests/e2e/transcript.mjs from tests/e2e/claim.mjs, tests/e2e/claim-shop.mjs and tests/e2e/try-payout.mjs. No secrets; email addresses are replaced by <email>. Sandbox only: no real money moved.

claim.about: The owner's claim: presets, a streamed claim, firm review, the firm's approval, a real sandbox payout at $1.25 and the receipt.

steps.step: browser: the claim page checks a photo and shows the result
steps.detail: Please send a photo of your own product. in 562 ms

steps.step: preset official-image: asks for the owner's own photo
steps.detail: Please send a photo of your own product.

steps.step: preset official-image: own-photo check is the reason, and nothing is paid
preset blurry: a friendly retake from the quality precheck
steps.detail: The photo is a bit blurry. Please take it again.

steps.step: presets list: the examples, each with its expected result, and the opened-charger photos with their recorded results
preset download is a JSON file
preset photo downloads
streamed claim: events arrive in order (claim, stage, result)
steps.detail: claim,stage,result

steps.step: streamed claim: the official picture gets the own-photo retake
steps.detail: Please send a photo of your own product.

steps.step: a retake cannot be paid
steps.detail: This claim needs a new photo before it can be paid. Request id: req_f7f7f133744b439ca8c7

steps.step: claim with no live AI goes to firm review at the test amount
steps.detail: 4fd9f806-5be2-4b90-b22a-39ed6bc6a5d8 C1:unavailable C2:unavailable C3:unavailable C4:pass C5:pass C6:pass

steps.step: paying with no payee asks where to send it
steps.detail: Add the email or phone number of your PayPal account, so we know where to send the refund. Request id: req_dbf4142155a74d3581c1

steps.step: a short phone number is refused in plain words
steps.detail: Please use a 10-digit US phone number. Request id: req_1b0cdd82a8c44f3daac9

steps.step: firm review: the payee is kept and the payment waits for the firm
steps.detail: A person at the recalling firm will approve this payment.

steps.step: the payee is shown masked, never in full
steps.detail: <email>

steps.step: paying again changes nothing
the test approval route does not exist without CHECKS_SECRET
the firm approves and the payout is sent
steps.detail: On its way. PayPal is sending it now. ASTALY92ZV7BW

steps.step: PayPal reports the payout paid (polling, as the receipt does)
steps.detail: 16 s, SUCCESS, item 9JZTG5ZC8TNXL

steps.step: the receipt says Paid $1.25, with the sandbox payout ID and the labels
the claim photo is served for the receipt
a malformed claim id is refused
routes carry rate-limit headers

claim-shop.about: Buy the sample charger in the PayPal sandbox, claim it with the sale linked, see it verified from the verify cache with no model call, and see the refund go back to the original capture.

steps.step: sample shop order created
purchase captured and stored as a sale
the claim links the purchase
steps.detail: {"item":"Brightline 65W laptop charger (sample)","amount":"34.99","status":"linked","paid_at":"2026-11-09T14:04:54.000Z","days_left":179,"refundable_until":"2027-05-08T14:04:54.000Z"}

steps.step: verified: right charger, cord cut, own photo (answered by the verify cache, no Claude call)
steps.detail: verified by reviewers; C1 unclear, C2 pass, C3 pass, C4 pass, C5 pass, C6 pass; 2185 ms; cache hit

steps.step: C6 asks PayPal about the capture: no earlier refund or dispute
steps.detail: capture COMPLETED, 34.99 USD; refunded at PayPal 0.00, by Remedy 0.00; disputes 0; order read through PayPal's MCP server (get_order)

steps.step: the refund is the lower of the firm's $34.99 and the purchase
no payee needed: the router picks a refund to the original capture
steps.detail: You paid with PayPal today, so the refund goes back to that same payment.

steps.step: the firm's auto rule approves it ($34.99 is under the $50.00 cap) and the refund is sent, with no person
steps.detail: sent: Refunded to the account they paid with.

steps.step: PayPal completes the refund to the capture
steps.detail: refund 05P20398D52399712; photo to verified 2.2 s, photo to PayPal COMPLETED 5.6 s

steps.step: the receipt says Refunded $34.99 to your PayPal payment
the same purchase cannot be linked to a second claim
steps.detail: That purchase already has a claim, so this one is checked on its own.

try-payout.about: The one-click sandbox payout on /try: the sample charger verified, Send $34.99 to the sandbox buyer, the receipt with PayPal's batch id, PayPal reporting it paid, and a second press shown the latest receipt.

steps.step: the first example is Brightline's sample charger, cord cut
the result opens full width below the examples, with focus on it
steps.detail: 1184 px against a 387 px card

steps.step: once verified, the result offers the sandbox payout, labelled as one
PayPal accepted the payout: sent, $34.99, to the sandbox buyer, with a batch id
steps.detail: On its way. PayPal is sending it now. batch 4H3TW3TNRK2DW

steps.step: the page opens the receipt
steps.detail: the run opened its own claim's receipt; the recorded copy is /r/recorded

steps.step: PayPal reports the payout paid
steps.detail: 18 s, SUCCESS, item CWYH6T5VUMGDS

steps.step: the receipt shows the sandbox payout batch and the paid status
steps.detail: Sandbox payout ID CWYH6T5VUMGDS, batch 4H3TW3TNRK2DW, PayPal status SUCCESS

steps.step: a second press the same day sends nothing and shows the most recent receipt
